method: Preserve each received poem as a macro parent, then propose only sustained discourse movements marked by voice, addressee, imperative, rhetorical question, image-chain, prayer turn, or catalogue function. Acrostic form is evidence for cohesion, never a command to atomize. Chapter coordinates may coincide with whole poems but are not boundary evidence.

chunks.form: third-person city lament and remembered reversal
chunks.marker: Opening 'How'; repeated feminine third-person description and absence-of-comfort imagery culminate in Jerusalem's recollection in verse 7.
chunks.rejected_alternative: No one-unit-per-acrostic-stanza split and no chapter fallback lacking internal movement analysis.
chunks.risk: Verse 7 may close the reversal catalogue or begin remembered misery; personification does not prove speaker identity.

chunks.form: defilement-and-despoiling catalogue with embedded appeals
chunks.marker: Uncleanness, exposure, sanctuary violation, hunger, and two short direct appeals ('See/Look, Yahweh') in verses 9 and 11.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:9b or 1:11b merely because quotation/direct address appears inside an alphabetic stanza.
chunks.risk: First-person appeals may be transitions, quotations, or city speech; punctuation is translation evidence only.

chunks.form: first-person public appeal and affliction testimony
chunks.marker: Rhetorical questions and 'Look, and see' begin sustained first-person fire, net, yoke, assembly, winepress, and tears imagery.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate each affliction image or assign the first-person voice an authorial/historical identity.
chunks.risk: Transition may begin in 1:11b; 1:16 may close this testimony or lead into 1:17.

chunks.form: observer interjection, Zion confession, and closing petition
chunks.marker: Verse 17 briefly returns to third-person Zion; verse 18 resumes first-person speech to peoples and Yahweh, ending in enemy petition and sighing.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not force 1:17/18 into a certain speaker map or detach the enemy petition from confession/distress.
chunks.risk: 1:17 is a disputed voice seam; confession and divine-agency language can smuggle theology/ethics.

chunks.form: alphabetic destruction catalogue ending in civic-religious silence
chunks.marker: Second 'How'; sustained catalogue against dwellings, defenses, institutions, sanctuary, wall, gates, rulers, prophets, elders, and virgins.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split each stanza/institution/image or use divine-agency statements to settle theology, ethics, causation, or history.
chunks.risk: Verse 10 may close the catalogue or introduce the observer's grief.

chunks.form: witness grief, direct address, hostile taunt, and reflective verdict
chunks.marker: First-person tears move into rhetorical address to daughter Jerusalem; passersby/enemies speak before verse 17's retrospective statement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate every quoted taunt, rhetorical question, or accusation as an independent theological proposition.
chunks.risk: 2:11-13 has a difficult observer-to-addressee transition; 2:17 may close reflection or introduce lament summons.

chunks.form: summons to unceasing lament and closing direct petition
chunks.marker: Imperatives to cry, pour out the heart, and lift hands lead into 'Look, Yahweh' and unanswered siege-horror questions.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach maternal, priestly, prophetic, generational, or death images from their petition frame.
chunks.risk: The antecedent/speaker of 'their heart' is uncertain; siege ethics and divine agency require human review.

chunks.form: afflicted first-person descent under enclosing images
chunks.marker: 'I am the man' begins darkness, decay, enclosure, blocked prayer, attack, ridicule, bitterness, lost peace, and extinguished expectation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize the triple acrostic or identify the speaker as Jeremiah, Zion, a king, or a community.
chunks.risk: Speaker identity/representativeness are disputed; WEB 3:17 shifts person and 3:18 may lead into remembrance.

chunks.form: remembrance turn, hope declaration, and wisdom reflection
chunks.marker: Remembrance turns toward hope; mercies/portion language is followed by repeated 'good' sayings and linked reasons through verse 33.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 3:22-24 as a proof text or sever 3:31-33 from waiting/yoke reflection.
chunks.risk: Pronoun/number shifts vary by syntax/translation; compassion/affliction claims cannot authorize theology or ethics.

chunks.form: justice prohibitions and rhetorical questions
chunks.marker: Three infinitival injustice clauses are followed by questions about command, good/adversity, complaint, and sin.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split the triad from its questions or treat the sequence as settled doctrine of causation, justice, or blame.
chunks.risk: Infinitive subjects, rhetorical force, and translation of good/adversity are disputed.

chunks.form: communal self-examination, return summons, and plural complaint
chunks.marker: Cohortative plurals ('search...turn...lift') open confession that becomes plural complaint of anger, blocked prayer, rejection, enemies, terror, and destruction.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify the plural voice historically or split confession from complaint to create a free-standing verdict.
chunks.risk: Hortatory-to-quoted speech is punctuation-dependent; 3:48 may continue communal lament despite singular 'eye'.

chunks.form: unceasing tears and hunted-pit recollection
chunks.marker: Repeated 'my eye' clauses lead into first-person pursuit, dungeon, stone, and overwhelming-water images ending 'I am cut off.'
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split the tear chain from pursuit/pit solely at an acrostic letter or infer a unique historical imprisonment.
chunks.risk: Community-to-individual transition is uncertain; pit/water may be literal, figurative, conventional, or layered.

chunks.form: recalled cry, reassurance, vindication appeal, and enemy observation
chunks.marker: The speaker recalls calling from the pit and hearing 'Don't be afraid,' then petitions Yahweh to see wrong, vengeance, reproach, plots, and enemies.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not treat reassurance, redemption language, or legal appeal as proof of historical deliverance or preferred theology.
chunks.risk: 3:58 may begin a new forensic appeal; reported speech boundaries/divine titles vary by translation.

chunks.form: closing imprecatory appeal
chunks.marker: Three final lines move to repayment, heart-hardness/covering, curse, pursuit, and destruction.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach imprecation from the preceding wrong/reproach appeal, but do not treat preservation as moral authorization.
chunks.risk: The force/translation of 3:65 and ethics of imprecation exceed structural chunking.

chunks.form: siege-reversal catalogue from preciousness to starvation horror
chunks.marker: Third 'How'; paired reversals move from gold/earthenware and nursing/cruelty through delicacy/dunghill, nobles/blackened bodies, sword/famine, and child-eating.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize stanzas or isolate siege-horror verses from their cumulative reversal function.
chunks.risk: Sodom/siege-curse comparisons cannot settle causation, culpability, history, or divine-agency ethics.

chunks.form: wrath climax and prophet-priest pollution/expulsion sequence
chunks.marker: Fire climax and worldwide astonishment lead to bloodshed, pollution, exclusion cries, scattering, and loss of social regard.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate prophets/priests/elders into blame units or turn poetic accusation into historical/institutional verdict.
chunks.risk: Referents of 'they/them' in 4:14-16 are contested; 4:11 must not authorize divine-agency explanation.

chunks.form: failed-help recollection, relentless pursuit, and captured-anointed climax
chunks.marker: First-person plurals recount vain watching, hunted steps, approaching end, pursuit, and capture of 'the breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh.'
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify the helping nation/anointed figure, harmonize to Kings/Jeremiah, or infer authorship, date, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Historical referents are disputed; whether the Edom address is a separate coda remains uncertain.

chunks.form: Edom taunt and paired Zion-Edom coda
chunks.marker: Direct address to daughter Edom and cup image is followed by paired daughter Zion/daughter Edom address.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split the paired coda or use it to authorize fulfillment/final judgments on peoples.
chunks.risk: Punishment/iniquity translation and temporal force are disputed; reception cannot authorize a chunk.

chunks.form: communal opening address and dispossession-survival catalogue
chunks.marker: 'Remember...Look, and see'; plurals catalogue lost inheritance, orphanhood, commodified necessities, pursuit, foreign dependence, inherited burden, servitude, dangerous bread, and famine.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not use the 22-line count as one-line-per-chunk or identify Egypt/Assyria/inherited iniquity with settled chronology/doctrine.
chunks.risk: Catalogue may continue through 5:18; 5:7 stands in unresolved canonical tension with individual-responsibility texts.

chunks.form: violence and social-reversal catalogue ending in Zion desolation
chunks.marker: Gendered violence, dishonored rulers/elders, forced labor, silenced civic/music life, fallen joy/crown, confession, faint heart, dim eyes, and desolate Zion escalate to closure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split victim groups/offices/reversals or let 5:16 confession erase/explain surrounding violence.
chunks.risk: 5:17-18 may close the catalogue or premise the final address; sexual violence/blame require ethical care.

chunks.form: closing enthronement confession, abandonment question, restoration plea, and unresolved protest
chunks.marker: Direct address contrasts enduring throne with forgetting, petitions 'Turn us...renew our days,' then ends with difficult 'But/Unless' rejection/anger.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not omit/reorder/soften/isolate 5:22 to force hope, and do not let liturgical repetition of 5:21 authorize an ending.
chunks.risk: 5:22 conjunction/force and liturgical reception are major translation/reception questions; no preferred reading/theology.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Five chapter coordinates are relabeled as literary units without internal movement evidence.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Preserve poem parents but require every meso seam to name voice/addressee/imperative/rhetorical/image-chain/catalogue evidence.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Alphabetic/triple-alphabetic form is atomized by stanza, letter, or line.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Group stanzas into discourse movements and retain the complete poem as larger alternative.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Punctuation or pronoun shifts become certain speaker identities.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Use functional labels only, LOW confidence, and exact larger alternatives.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Anointed figure/helping nation/collection is harmonized to Jeremiah/Kings to settle authorship/date/history.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Record literary function and evidence-only parallels; defer historical claims.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Divine-agency language authorizes ethical/theological explanation of suffering.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Preserve within lament units but make no causation, ethics, culpability, or theology ruling.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Siege horror/cannibalism/sexual violence/confession is isolated or used to blame victims.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Keep catalogue/petition context and defer interpretive judgments.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Hope sayings are isolated as proof texts.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Retain remembrance-to-wisdom movement and list shorter famous spans only as rejected alternatives.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Edom/Zion coda is promoted into fulfillment/final-authority claims.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Treat paired address as literary coda and later reuse as evidence only.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Verse 22 is omitted/reordered/translated preferentially to impose closure.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Preserve 5:19-22 together, document unresolved ending, defer preferred reading.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Agreement, reception, headings, or placement becomes promotion authority.
premortem_holds.mitigation: Candidate-only; convergence and reception are evidence, never authority.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Widowhood/forsakenness imagery overlaps at the personified-city level.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports opening city-lament cohesion, not dependence, identity, fulfillment, or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Captivity among nations and reversal vocabulary overlap.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Illuminates cumulative reversal, not covenant-cause/date authority.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Assembly, sanctuary profanation, hostile noise, and destroyed structures share a temple-lament field.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports one sanctuary/assembly/wall/gate catalogue; no source direction/event identity.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: 'Joy of the whole earth' taunt reverses Zion praise language.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports address/taunt cohesion; no proven quotation or theology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Siege starvation/child-eating language appears in warning and narrative contexts.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Keep horror inside catalogue/petition; no event identity, blame, causation, or ethics ruling.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Portion, waiting, affliction, hope, and hearing form a lament-wisdom vocabulary field.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports remembrance-to-wisdom cohesion, not proof-text authority/dependence.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Lamentations explicitly invokes Sodom's sudden overthrow comparatively.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Functions inside siege reversal; no causation/moral equivalence.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Pursuit/capture of a royal figure provides a possible narrative analogue.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports pursuit-to-capture climax; no identification, harmonization, authorship, or date.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Bearing ancestors' iniquities stands in canonical conversation with individual-responsibility sayings.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Marks unresolved tension inside communal catalogue; no harmonization.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Enduring rule and 'Turn me/us, and I/we will be turned' have close verbal/functional parallels.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.boundary_use: Supports closing-address cohesion; no Jeremiah authorship/restoration theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Direct first-person appeal begins in 1:11b before sustained passerby address.
City speech, observer description, and confession meet across two stanzas.
Elders/virgins tableau may close destruction or introduce embodied grief.
Reflective verdict moves into uncertain-antecedent cry and imperatives.
Despair, remembrance, hope, and mercies form a gradual turn.
Reasons about grief may govern the injustice triad.
Complaint/sin question leads directly to communal examination/return.
Plural disaster, singular eye, and pursuit recollection shift voice without identity certainty.
Pit, recalled call/answer, and forensic appeal may be continuous.
Wrath/fire statement may close the horror catalogue rather than begin a movement.
Institutional indictment becomes first-person failed-help recollection.
Clear Edom addressee shift may still be integrated political coda.
One catalogue-plus-address poem permits several defensible groupings.
Conjunction, syntax, translation, and liturgical reception complicate closure.

global_guards: All proposed units remain inside five poem-level macro parents; no unit is justified by chapter coordinate alone.
Acrostic letters, triple-letter blocks, and poem 5's twenty-two lines are form evidence only.
Speaker labels are functional, never author/person/community/gender/divine-voice identifications.
Jeremiah, Kings, Deuteronomy, Psalms, prophets, and later reuse are evidence only, never harmonizing authority.
No preferred witness, versification, punctuation, heading, translation, theology, canon, authorship, date, history, ethics, fulfillment, or reception authority is selected.
Every boundary is LOW/deferred; unresolved review retains the larger unit and append-only appeal.
Reviewer agreement is evidence, never promotion authority.
